title: BLS powers-of-tau k36: x-only leaves, beta-triple giant lookups, leaf planner, N_b/N_g = 27/20 on k35

claims.statement: For the protected BLS12-381 powers-of-tau target, the complete paired class-walk algorithm and argument supplied here has W(2^20)<=2^116.019089947141448 reference units at C=2000 and success>=0.39 conditional on explicitly disclosed H1-H5 in source-proof.md with H4 restated as the per-class floors of proof.md section 30 (pair fraction F=998/1000 and leaf share 96/100, both checked per class before any group operation). It uses only A_1 and A_(2^20), and the same W(n) bound holds for 2^20<=n<r. Preprocessing, failure/cap work, communication, verification, recovery included. Total memory<2^122.0004 bytes, preprocessing<2^115.0399 units and included, no advice. Analytical conditional bound, not a production execution. Section 30: records keyed by x (limbs 1..3 of x'); babies insert one record, giants look up x', beta x', beta^2 x' (beta_keys, 343 per giant point on the shipped product body, executed); a pair child that is no midpoint runs the leaf kernel (the measured kernel cut after x', 596 worst path, executed); centre-first planner with GMAX=2^47, DEPTH=2^17; N_b=ceil(27 N_g/20); baby point 3651412546123/3276800000, giant point 4939604546123/3276800000 instructions. s26-s28: executed batch round, no reference addition. s1: 929-instruction kernel, Callgrind-measured; s2: target K 0.49511789492; s9-25, s29: record path; s15: restart price SMX 630722.

experiments.purpose: Recompute the amended ledger + exact log ceiling; rerun the s30 planner (per-class pair fractions and leaf shares, capped and uncapped), the toy curve recovery with x-keys and three giant lookups at N_b/N_g = 27/20, transport simulation, census at 27/20, the word-level audits of measure/side_lanes.S and its P+T variant (paths, 509 lanes, stride footprint), the s30 leaf kernel and its P+T copy (paths, 365 lanes each, footprint), the beta_keys routine, the executed s26-s28 batch round with both side calls, the K1 carry-bound witness and the record-path audits. Finite evidence only.
